messages.subject: Meridian/Harcourt – kickoff and drafting plan
messages.plaintextBody:
Team,

Kicking off WC-00199 (Meridian Signal Analytics – Harcourt Beverages MSSA). Commercial heads attached in the matter folder. Plan:

- Elena: first draft MSSA on our standard supplier terms. Open with general cap at 100% of trailing 12-month fees and the data-protection super-cap also at 100% (we expect Harcourt to push hard on this).
- James: Order Form, SOW, SLA and DPA.
- Service Commencement Date 5 Jan 2026, so we have a real deadline.

Let's get v1 out to Marlowe Greaves by 26 Sept.

Sarah

Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
